title: In the Matter door lock applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0…
description: A vulnerability in the Matter door lock applications of Nordic Semiconductor's nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.1 allows suspended users to unlock doors. The AccessManager::ValidateCredential() function does not check the owning user's status and returns success even when no owning user is resolved. This enables users with a suspended status (OccupiedDisabled) or orphaned credentials to continue unlocking doors. The issue is fixed in version 1.2.0.
